future_real_entry: existing authenticated UI usage-confirmation mechanism; not yet connected for this new pack

model_settings.model: same configured model for both model arms

effective_test_settings.input_policy: identical full raw candidate rows and task conditions; planner sees actual sequences
effective_test_settings.response_policy: provider incomplete remains a failure; never silently extend or retry for a better answer
effective_test_settings.budget_policy: same per-request output cap for both model arms; agent can make multiple requests
effective_test_settings.failure_policy: Stop remaining user rounds after execution/transport/planning/budget failure; retain NOT_EXECUTED records
effective_test_settings.timeout_enforcement: Cooperative checks before/after calls; no claim of interrupting a blocking transport
effective_test_settings.physical_attempts_policy: API retries belong to each logical request; real API path remains disabled
